description: PAI - Quadro del dissesto is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geomap.reteunitaria.piemonte.it. Information sheets relating to the failure picture set out in Annex 2 (Atlas of hydraulic and hydrogeological risks) to the Stralcio Plan for Hydrogeological Planning – PAI – approved by the Prime Ministerial Decree of 24 May 2001 and updated by means of urban planning instruments (General Regulatory Plans – PRG). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PAI - Fault picture" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pai, frane quiescenti, valanghe, frane, conoidi, opendata. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-07-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
